tone.summary: A pristine signal chain utilizing a Comp for warmth, followed by a clean pre-amp (US Deluxe/Silver Twin) into an AC30 TB model. The core tone is built around Chorus and Digital Delay for massive space, topped off with Plate reverb to achieve the signature Gilmour sustain.
